spec.name: explore-h001-s0
spec.notes: explore: h001: Run seeds 0 and 1 with six bottom blocks frozen and otherwise retain the freeze+wavg settings. I predict only 0.2 points more forgetting than freeze+wavg, with legal perplexity ratio 0.760–0.776.
